subject: BrightConf - emergency surge credit allocation for partner livestream
messages:
From: Sofia Park <sofia@brightconf.io>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: streamops@brightconf.io
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:47:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Promo codes for the BrightConf livestream — urgent

Thanks Alex — quick update from our side. Registration just jumped after the keynote speaker announcement and we’re seeing a 40% bump in attendees for the co-hosted track. A handful of enterprise partners want access codes for internal teams (estimated 300 users total).

We can accept a single batch from Redwood but need it in the next 48 hours to include in confirmation emails. Can you confirm whether you can provide an emergency micro-allocation (~300 trial credits) and a CSV mapping?

—Sofia
Support: streamops@brightconf.io
From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: Sofia Park <sofia@brightconf.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for the BrightConf livestream — urgent

Sofia — thanks for the heads up. We can support a temporary top-up of trial credits, but I need signoff from marissa (marketing budget) and a quick ops checklist so fulfillment isn’t manual.

Two asks from my side:
- Marissa: can we approve a one-off allocation of 300 free trial credits from the co-marketing pool? If yes, confirm the token size (e.g., 1,000 tokens / account) so we can generate codes.
- StreamOps: provide the CSV template you want for auto-import (email, company, allotment).

I’ll queue the credit generation as soon as Marissa confirms and Finance OKs the promo. If there’s any PII constraints, flag them now.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 10:08:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for the BrightConf livestream — urgent

Alex — I approve a temporary allocation of 300 trial credit bundles from the co-marketing reserve. Conditions:
- Bundle = 1,200 tokens (enough for basic evaluation).
- Validity = 30 days.
- We’ll cap redemptions to one per email address and require acceptance of the partner terms.

Naomi and Grace, please confirm ops and tagging so we can track conversions. I’ve attached the fulfillment checklist and the signed MOP brief (internal approval).

Marissa Cole
Senior Growth Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: credit-fulfillment-checklist.xlsx; signed-mop-brief.pdf
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 12:03:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for the BrightConf livestream — urgent

Looping in ops details. We can generate 300 unique codes as requested and export a CSV that matches BrightConf’s template. Confirmed tagging: campaign=brightconf_aug2027; source=partner-webinar.

Fulfillment plan (high level):
- Code format: RBW-XXXX-YYYY
- Per-code allotment: 1,200 tokens, expiry 30 days from first redemption
- Rate-limit: one code per email, require account creation for redemption
- Delivery: we will send a CSV to streamops@brightconf.io and also upload the codes to their import link (if they provide one).

Two small blockers: DocuSign shows a missing signature on page 3 (minor legal tweak). Can you confirm Marissa that we’re good to proceed without delay? If legal needs the signed doc, we’ll need up to 6 business hours to re-run.

—Naomi
Operations, Redwood Inference
